text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from going out with Dream 
Journey. She mentioned wanting to stop by 
somewhere, so—
choice_data_list: If you'd like, shall I come with you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: No. That's not quite it. However—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You'll “regret it” if you follow me, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"If you truly do not mind, please do as 
you please. You are most welcome."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where Dream Journey headed was an art 
exhibition by a contemporary artist who 
has been gaining prominence in recent 
years.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This artist's work is said to be 
characterized by complex expressions of 
black, achieved by layering dozens of 
colors upon one another.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The depth of thought dwelling within was 
bottomless, yet it would never reveal its 
depths until one dared to peer inside.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The courage to step into the darkness in 
order to seek knowledge. Sometimes I 
wonder if that is what is being tested.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How was it? Was it perhaps a little boring 
for you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Dream Journey continued 
to explain the artists' distinctive 
brushwork and materials in meticulous 
detail.
choice_data_list:
Thanks to you, I've gotten a lot more 
interested in that author.

text_block_list.text: Um... Sorry for the sudden intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I run an art gallery nearby. I 
just recently acquired a small piece by 
the artist you were talking about.

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text:
You all are truly in luck! With that 
artist's work, simply keeping it for a few 
years will multiply its value several 
times over!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely oblivious to my wariness, the 
self-proclaimed art dealer aggressively 
pushed the pieces he pulled from his bag.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Facing such an authoritative attitude that 
declared art as their specialty, it took a 
bit of courage to argue back, but—

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think of this black! When 
you think of this artist, you think black 
abstracts! Right? There's no mistaking it!
choice_data_list:
B-But... the black lacks depth, doesn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Trying to show off in front of 
your companion, are we? However, this 
painting is the genuine article, an 
authentic—
choice_data_list:
That author's black is not this 
monotonous.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This artist's work is said to be 
characterized by complex expressions of 
black, achieved by layering dozens of 
colors upon one another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try to hide my trembling hands from the 
nerves. Even if my knowledge is just 
cramming, I have complete trust in what 
Dream Journey brought me.

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, my apologies. I completely 
forgot I have another business meeting 
coming up.

text_block_list.name: Art Dealer?
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but I must take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufufu...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha. Splendid! A truly magnificent 
repelling of the threat.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? Since long ago, works of art 
have been an attractive investment target 
for "certain types of people."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, due to its high value, there is 
no end to counterfeiters trying to 
capitalize on it.
choice_data_list: Then what happened earlier was really...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's a scam, of course. I am so glad you 
didn't fall for it, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Knowledge can, at times, serve as an 
impenetrable suit of armor to protect 
oneself.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That said—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Poor thing... They seemed terribly 
nervous."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't I warn you? 'Follow me, and you'll 
regret it.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Someone as kindhearted as you should 
never be near places of malice to begin 
with."
choice_data_list: Still, you can't stop the desire to know!

You can't just run away—you have to study, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well now... What an exceptionally 
straightforward gaze you have.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you possess it? A talent, 
of sorts, for peering into the other side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Dream Journey's wry smile, I 
ended up unable to ask what "the other 
side" was really like.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
A wonderful thought. After all, it is far 
more entertaining to deceive than to be 
deceived.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I'm only joking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with her teasing gaze, I resolved to 
build up more knowledge.
